tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries (and trade blocs) with data: ISO code, region, a one-line headline and which topics each one has.

tools.name: find_visas
tools.description: Search digital nomad, retirement (pensionado) and investor visas across countries, cheapest entry first. Filter by the most a person can show: monthly USD income for digital_nomad and retirement, USD investment for investor. Returns summary rows; use get_country_profile for full requirements.

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description: Everything on one country, starting with a summary (headline sentence, lowest visa minimums, years to citizenship, tax system, monthly cost, safety rank, programs researched and found not to exist, and the oldest and newest verification dates). Then: visas, years from residency to permanent residenc

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: The full record of one residency, visa or citizenship program: requirements, minimum income or investment, stay rules, years to permanent residency and citizenship, fees, processing time, legal basis and sources, plus its country summary. Use the program_id from find_visas, get_country_profile or ge

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Side-by-side rows for several countries on one topic, e.g. tax_systems for Panama, Paraguay and Uruguay.

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Side-by-side summary of 2 to 8 residency, visa or citizenship programs: minimum income or investment, years to citizenship, stay requirement, processing time, government fee, tax system and links. Pass program_ids from find_visas or get_program, or program names.

tools.name: get_settlement_blocs
tools.description: Agreements that let citizens of one member country live in another: the MERCOSUR Residence Agreement, the Andean Migratory Statute and CARICOM free movement, with conditions, years to permanent residency, legal basis, and which Latin American passports qualify. Pass a country to see which agreements

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Every row of one topic, optionally for one country. Requires a commercial API key: https://mylatinlife.com/api/v1/plan?src=tools

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated log of what changed in this data, newest first: changed visa minimums, fees, processing times and years to residency or citizenship (changed, with from and to), countries added to or taken off tax blacklists (listed, delisted), and programs or details MyLatinLife added to its coverage (coverag

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: The newest articles and guides published on mylatinlife.com, optionally only those whose title matches a search, with links, dates and a short excerpt.

tools.name: find_mll_service
tools.description: MyLatinLife's own services, for when the user wants someone to handle a residency, citizenship, banking, tax, document or company application for them: the service name, its page, and whether it starts online or with a consultation call. MyLatinLife is a relocation service provider. Filter by countr

tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: MyLatinLife's YouTube videos on residency, citizenship, banking, tax, cost of living and life in Latin America, newest first, optionally for one country or matching words in the title.

tools.name: about_data
tools.description: What this server covers: every topic with its row count and the oldest and newest verification dates, the countries covered, when the change log starts, the terms of use and how to cite MyLatinLife.

tools.name: check_tax_blacklists
tools.description: Which tax and AML blacklists or greylists (EU Annex I/II, OECD, FATF, national lists) a jurisdiction is on, with legal basis and consequences.
